text:
sanjay: quick heads-up — when we swapped from Gemma-7B -> Qwen-7B (quantized int8 with our new kernel) some long-context prompts start returning repeated fragments after ~2k tokens. looks like a token-id/phase mismatch
marta: ugh. can you paste an example?
sanjay: short repro: feed a 3k prompt (news article + Q/A) and generate 1k tokens. output drifts into repetition consistently on the qwen build but not on gemma. minimal diff in runner: only model + tokenizer + quant bits
sanjay: tokenizer probe shows weird aliasing: gemma tokenizer: [101, 202, 303, 404] -> tokens: ["The","study","found","that"]
sanjay: qwen tokenizer on same bytes: [103, 205, 305, 404] -> tokens: ["The","study","found","that"]
sanjay: note the shifted ids (offset by +2 for most tokens). embeddings shape matches but kv-cache seems to index by token id so that explains misaligned past keys
kai: that offset explains a lot. did we accidentally load a different vocab file or apply a byte fallback mapping?
sanjay: checked: vocab files came from model tarball. sizes identical. diffing first 200 entries shows every id shifted starting at index 3. looks like an upstream tokenizer migration used a reserved sentinel.
marta: could be rotary/positional param interaction too — if rotary base or scale changed, older kv cache indexing might still be valid but phase is wrong and causes repeating loops at long context
sanjay: ran quick eval:
```
model,setup,perplexity,repeat_rate
gemma-7b,float32,12.2,0.6%
qwen-7b,int8,13.1,18.4%
qwen-7b,int8,(with vocab-remap fix),12.3,1.1%
```
so remapping ids back to gemma's layout fixes repetition mostly
kai: nice! what's the remap approach? a runtime offset table?
sanjay: cheap patch: build a remap vector of length vocab_size where remap[new_id] = old_id then apply before embedding lookup and before kv-cache writes/reads. patched in model adapter layer, no retrain.
marta: will that break any output detokenization? need to ensure we only remap internal ids not the tokenizer outputs used for metrics
sanjay: yep we remap only the token ids used for embedding/kv. tokenizer.serialize still uses qwen vocab (so detok stays consistent). CI runs token-roundtrip checks — passed locally
eval-bot: automated eval run queued: perf/regression suite > token-roundtrip, longgen-stability, ppl-checks. queued as #4829
ci-bot: ps: flagged as potential infra issue because kernel fallback triggered on some cards during int8 run. tagging eng-infra
kai: next steps: 1) confirm remap for other models (mistral variants) 2) add unit test comparing first-2k token ids across model builds 3) small perf hit measurement for remap vector (should be negligible)
marta: also add a check for rotary config mismatches on model load: if rotary_base or scale != expected, warn and optionally apply backward-compatible transform
sanjay: I'll open a PR with remap prototype + tests and attach failing sample prompts. putting it under a feature flag until we can coordinate with model onboarding docs
kai: thanks. cc @marta please add to onboarding checklist (vocab id continuity, rotary params, tokenizer version)
marta: will do. thanks for the quick debug, sanjay :tada:
